camel_example: aliyun dts DescribeSubscriptionInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key testkey1 --SubscriptionInstanceName 'MySQL订阅' --AccountId 123233440000 --PageSize 30 --PageNum 1 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekz4us4iruleja' --Tag.1.Value testvalue1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000'
description_en: Queries the list of change tracking instances and the details of each instance
description_zh: 查询订阅实例列表和各订阅实例详情
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-subscription-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-size 30 --page-num 1 --subscription-instance-name 'MySQL订阅' --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --account-id 123233440000 --tag Value=testvalue1 Key=testkey1 --resource-group-id rg-aekz4us4iruleja --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSubscriptionInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49442.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49442.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30、50、100，默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer greater than 0 and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en:
The name of the change tracking instance.
If you specify this parameter, DTS returns the change tracking instances that contain the specified name in the response
parameters.help_zh:
订阅实例名称。
传入本参数后，DTS将在调用结果中返回包含该名称的订阅实例
parameters.name: subscription_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag.
N specifies the sequence number of the tag key. For example, Tag.1.Key specifies the key of the first tag, and Tag.2.Key specifies the key of the second tag. You can query 1 to 20 tag keys at a time.
Empty strings are not allowed
fields.help_zh:
标签的键。
N表示传入第几个标签的键。例如：Tag.1.Key表示传入第一个标签的键；Tag.2.Key表示传入第二个标签的键。可以同时查询1~20个标签键。
不允许传入空字符串
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag.
N specifies the sequence number of the tag value. For example, Tag.1.Value specifies the value of the first tag, and Tag.2.Value specifies the value of the second tag. You can query 1 to 20 tag values at a time.
Empty strings are allowed
fields.help_zh:
标签的值。
N表示传入第几个标签的值。例如：Tag.1.Value表示传入第一个标签的值；Tag.2.Value表示传入第二个标签的值。可以同时查询1~20个标签值。
允许传入空字符串
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the data migration instance. These tags are used as filter conditions. If this parameter is specified, only instances that have the specified tags are returned
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移实例的标签，作为过滤项，当此项不为空时，仅拥有此标签的实例会返回
parameters.name: tag

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

PageRecordCount.description_en: The maximum number of records that can be displayed on the current page
PageRecordCount.description_zh: 当前页可展示的最大记录数

SubscriptionInstance.description_en: The list of change tracking instances and the details of each instance
SubscriptionInstance.description_zh: 数据订阅实例列表和各订阅实例的详情

items.description_en: The list of change tracking instances and the details of each instance
items.description_zh: 数据订阅实例列表和各订阅实例的详情

BeginTimestamp.description_en: The start of the timestamp range for data stored by the change tracking instance. The time is displayed in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
BeginTimestamp.description_zh: 订阅实例保存数据范围的起始时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

ConsumptionCheckpoint.description_en: The consumption checkpoint of the downstream client for the change tracking instance. The time is displayed in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
ConsumptionCheckpoint.description_zh: 订阅实例的下游消费时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

ConsumptionClient.description_en: The IP address and random identifier of the downstream client. The IP address is the IP address of the downstream client, and the random identifier is a random ID generated by DTS
ConsumptionClient.description_zh: 下游链接对应的IP和随机标识信息，其中IP为下游客户端的IP地址，随机标示为DTS生成的随机ID

EndTimestamp.description_en: The end of the timestamp range for data stored by the change tracking instance. The time is displayed in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
EndTimestamp.description_zh: 订阅实例保存数据范围的末尾时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message for the change tracking exception
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 数据订阅异常的错误提示

InstanceCreateTime.description_en: The time when the change tracking instance was created. The time is displayed in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
InstanceCreateTime.description_zh: 订阅实例创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

JobCreateTime.description_en: The time when the change tracking task was created. The time is displayed in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
JobCreateTime.description_zh: 订阅任务创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the change tracking instance. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
PayType.description_zh:
订阅实例的付费类型，返回值：
PrePaid：包年包月（预付费）。
PostPaid：按量付费（后付费）

SourceEndpoint.description_en: The connection information of the source instance

InstanceType.description_en:
The type of the source instance.
This parameter is returned only when the change tracking instance is of the new version
InstanceType.description_zh:
源实例类型。
当该订阅实例为新版时，才会返回该参数

Status.description_en:
The status of the change tracking instance. Valid values:

NotStarted: not started.
Prechecking: running a precheck.
PrecheckFailed: precheck failed.
Starting: starting.
Normal: running normally.
Abnormal: running abnormally
Status.description_zh:
订阅实例的状态，返回值为：

NotStarted：未启动。
Prechecking：预检查中。
PrecheckFailed：预检查失败。
Starting：启动中。
Normal：正常。
Abnormal：异常

SubscribeTopic.description_en:
The subscription topic.
This parameter is returned only when the change tracking instance is of the new version and a consumer group has been created by calling the [CreateConsumerGroup]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122863.html） operation
SubscribeTopic.description_zh:
订阅Topic。
当该订阅实例为新版，且调用[CreateConsumerGroup]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122863.html）接口创建了消费组时，才会返回本参数

SubscriptionDataType.description_en: The type of the subscribed data

DDL.description_en:
Indicates whether the subscribed data includes DDL statements. Valid values:

true: DDL statements are included.
false: DDL statements are not included
DDL.description_zh:
订阅数据是否包含DDL语句，返回值：

true：是。
false：否

DML.description_en:
Indicates whether the subscribed data includes DML statements. Valid values:

true: DML statements are included.
false: DML statements are not included
DML.description_zh:
订阅数据是否包含DML语句，返回值：

true：是。
false：否

SubscriptionHost.description_en: The endpoint of the change tracking instance

PrivateHost.description_en: The internal endpoint of the change tracking instance, in the format of `address:port`
PrivateHost.description_zh: 订阅实例的私网连接信息，格式为`地址：端口号`

PublicHost.description_en: The public endpoint of the change tracking instance, in the format of `address:port`
PublicHost.description_zh: 订阅实例的公网连接信息，格式为`地址：端口号`

VPCHost.description_en: The VPC endpoint of the change tracking instance, in the format of `address:port`
VPCHost.description_zh: 订阅实例的专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）连接信息，格式为`地址：端口号`

SubscriptionInstanceName.description_en: The name of the change tracking instance

DatabaseName.description_en: The name of the database to which the subscription object belongs
DatabaseName.description_zh: 订阅对象所属数据库的名称

Table.description_en: The table names of the subscription objects

items.description_en: The table names of the subscription objects

WholeDatabase.description_en:
Indicates whether the entire database is subscribed. Valid values:

true: The entire database is subscribed.
false: The entire database is not subscribed
WholeDatabase.description_zh:
是否订阅整库，返回值：

true：是。
false：否

Value.description_en: The tag value that corresponds to the tag key

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of change tracking instances that meet the specified conditions under the Alibaba Cloud account
TotalRecordCount.description_zh: 阿里云主账号下所有符合条件的数据订阅实例数量
